I.B05.01: The exact N to NA repair of A50 is proved. F3.15 independently proves the fixed-CM-curve pro-prime recognition assertion of A20, and F3.16 gives actual punctured quotient maps on one explicit cover. F3.17 exhibits the exact homology-detection limit with no arithmetic normalizer assertion. The arbitrary full profinite A22 common-kernel subgroup remains OPEN. F3.18 now proves the exact rank-one-to-CM quotient with actual Prym maps; F3.19 exhibits an absolutely simple CM surface in an actual cover; F3.20 proves pro-prime recognition for every punctured elliptic target. The arbitrary-cover higher-dimensional CM and full profinite A22 requirements remain OPEN. F3.21-F3.22 now prove actual normalizer recognition on the exhibited genus2 X5 target for EVERY prime and every finite number-field extension. The exact actual morphism Y20 to U5 therefore excludes the specified CM-surface homology image of an open-normalizer procyclic subgroup. Arbitrary-cover CM factors and full profinite A22 remain unresolved. F3.23 constructs an actual arithmetic-normal-core detector with a rational cusp, then an actual once-punctured Q-model preserving the nonzero proper homology and open normalizer. The full arithmetic orbit need not yet be identified with an entire CM symplectic basis; the universal quotient on that actual remaining constraint space is still required. F3.25 proves that an absolutely simple CM variety over Q has a Galois full endomorphism field and the actual G_Q orbit of one split eigenline is the whole paired basis. It also gives all-prime cusp recognition for once-punctured genus3 Q-curves with a whole absolutely simple Jacobian. A proper geometric CM factor in an arbitrary detecting-cover Jacobian is not substituted for that whole module. F3.26 proves full-basis-tangency q6 vanishing in every genus>=3 by exact support<=4 matrices and the three-handle trace projection. The equality relating q6 to restriction onto a proper symplectic CM summand remains unproved. F3.27 applies these exact maps to once-punctured Q-curves with a whole absolutely simple Jacobian of any genus>=3, at every prime and after every finite arithmetic base change. General detecting-cover Jacobians may be reducible, so this does not close the original subgroup gate. F3.28 proves q6 vanishing in genus3 for four actual basis-line tangencies spanning a proper symplectic four-dimensional summand, retaining the complementary handle and all mixed Johnson equations. Exact invariant contraction images lie in two actual geometric degree6 bracket images. It does not identify arbitrary detected CM lines with that paired summand, nor prove an all-genus proper-summand statement. F3.29 proves the single-line q6 obstruction and complete once-punctured genus3 normalizer recognition without any Jacobian-simplicity or CM-pairing hypothesis. It also proves balanced single-line-to-paired tangency in every genus. An arbitrary rational detecting curve can have higher genus; the all-genus mixed-normalizer/contraction argument remains unproved, so the full A22 assertion is retained. F3.30 gives the exact Levi-invariant finite input and coupled scalar-polynomial matrix reduction; the mixed matrix and its all-genus contraction-image conclusion remain uncomputed. F3.31 gives the exact full-profinite counterexample-to-matrix witness, including the original proper-homology detector and residual-pronilpotent case, and a finite Smith decision procedure. The main remaining sufficient gate is the unverified all-integer-parameter kernel inclusion; no subgroup resolution is recorded.
